actual_image_review.observations: Actual image inspection: visible Chinese title is correct. Two flat generic workers handle a paper strip on a table; the strip connects to a large angular folded crane form. Geometry differs substantially from the fibre-sheet papermaking sample. Warm paper, restrained red accent and small landscape texture; no event details, statistics or heritage claims. This is an imagined original craft concept and a method candidate, not stable batch acceptance.
actual_image_review.thumbnail_observation: At 180px the angular crane, vertical title and red circle dominate. The two workers and tabletop are tiny; detailed folding action cannot be verified in miniature. The crane-plus-red-circle association remains disputed and needs owner/audience review.
actual_image_review.scope: Agent inspection; not human aesthetic approval

followup_review.scope: Codex full-image and separate 180px thumbnail review; no new generation or human acceptance
followup_review.notes: The earlier cultural PASS is withdrawn. Crane and red circle may suggest Japanese symbolism to some Chinese readers; this association is an interpretation, not proof of copying. Both craft tests place workers at lower left and enlarge material upward/right, despite different title positions and material geometries. Cross-theme layout variation is not established.
